headline: Wardens Sweep Godcrofts; Wind Hills Work Reduced to Ruin
war_summary: Three hours past our last edition, the Wardens have completed their sweep of Godcrofts: nine of nine works now fly their colors after forty-nine actions in the day, the liveliest ground on the map, five exchanges coming inside the last two hours. In Mooring County, the Wind Hills post — contested eight times — has been reduced to no-man's-land, leaving eleven Warden works standing as Colonial casualties there accelerate. Fisherman's Row's ruined work is back on the Colonial roll, all nine posts in Colonial hands, thirty actions in the day attesting to unrelenting pressure. The Linn of Mercy has stirred from its quiet: one work lies in ruin, ten remain Colonial, and Warden losses run well beyond the Colonial count. The Weathered Expanse, deadlocked at four works apiece with one in ruin, has sprung back to life, Frostmarch and Wightwalk the busiest points; Stlican Shelf holds six Warden works to three, while Stonecradle, five to four, has gone silent these two hours. Callahan's Passage remains the costliest field, better than 10,000 Colonial and 7,600 Warden losses in the day. The ledger reads 285 Colonial works to 148 Warden, three in ruin; some 39,000 Colonial and 45,000 Warden dead these twenty-four hours. Day 236, and no victor declared.
